notes: All 35 exact batch keys appear once; no database or tracked project files were edited.
Only current importer field names are used: canonical_name, collection_context, developer, genre, original_platform, publisher, regional_release_date, and series.
A regional_release_date is included only when a source supplies a region or a clearly global/platform-specific release statement; each date declares day, month, or year precision.
Source choice favors official publisher/developer/store sources, then MobyGames, GameFAQs, LaunchBox, or a source directly tied to an unusual build where primary metadata is unavailable.
